patthana22.29:2.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.29:4.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava.
patthana22.29:5.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.29:6.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.29:7.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho arūpīdhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.29:8.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. satta.
patthana22.29:10.1: na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. satta. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.29:11.1: sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañcatiṃsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na
patthana22.29:12.1: kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.29:14.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana sappaṭigho
